rows.en: It's on our course: <pic(0)><cs(3)>northern Great Britain<ce()>. <mk(-62.5,62.5,1,0)><ar(0,1,0)>We'll now move to support the friendly craft.
rows.speaker: ? (Bright Noa or Noin)

rows.en: An identity check with Headquarters has confirmed that the pilot belongs to the UCE.
rows.speaker: ? (Bright Noa or Noin)

rows.en: Since the pilot's acting alone, they may have information on the classified material.
rows.speaker: ? (Bright Noa or Noin)

rows.en: I expect you to deal with this swiftly so it doesn't hinder our pursuit mission.
rows.speaker: ? (Bright Noa or Noin)

rows.en: Rumors of the <cs(1)>Titans<ce()> breaking away go back to when <cs(1)>OZ<ce()> began gaining power in the UCE.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: The ones who defected this time are a group of radicals within the Titans.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Next to the UCE and its major groups, they're small and won't sway the big picture, but
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: frankly, there's no telling what that lot will do. We'll need to stay on guard.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Also, it's been decided that Lieutenant Quattro will be operating with us.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: I can vouch for his skills. I want you all to work together from here on.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: If you're defeated, it's all for nothing. Approach your operations with more care.
